mapping.summary: AI planner for manufacturing forecasting, scheduling, OEE
claims: Manufacturing Assistant answers about at-risk orders, bottlenecks, shortages, OEE, scrap
Demand forecasting per item choosing Seasonal, Trend or Moving Average with confidence %
AI planning worksheet suggests runs rounded to order modifiers
Creates firm planned production orders and requisition lines
Visual schedule board with drag-and-drop rescheduling and routing recalculation
Capacity planning with overloads, bottleneck analysis and what-if extra shift
Capable-to-promise check exploding every BOM level
Touch, barcode-ready production terminal for labour, output, scrap, consumption and downtime
Shop floor assistant turns dictated sentence into a posting
OEE dashboard per work centre and downtime root-cause analysis
Eight alert detectors incl. late orders, shortages, overloads, scrap spikes, aged WIP
Supplier risk scores and OTIF benchmarking
Predicts maintenance needs, with checklists and maintenance orders
AI cost estimates converted to a linked sales quote
Production Planner role centre with eighteen KPI cues and optional Power BI pack
All releases, postings and changes require human confirmation
